description: Source code for the XCast plugin implementation, managing casting services, application control, and system interactions within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: XCast
classes.description: Main class implementing the casting service plugin, handling initialization, configuration, application management, and system events.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON RPC methods exposed by the plugin.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus and registers event handlers for power and standby mode changes.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Unregisters IARM event handlers and cleans up.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the system power state to ON, STANDBY, or TOGGLE.

methods.name: powerModeChange
methods.description: Handles power mode change events from IARM.

methods.name: networkStandbyModeChange
methods.description: Handles network standby mode change events.

methods.name: threadPowerModeChangeEvent
methods.description: Worker thread to handle power mode transitions and restart logic.

methods.name: networkStandbyModeChangeEvent
methods.description: Worker thread to handle network standby mode updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs plugin initialization, including creating the XCast instance, registering methods, and system setup.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters methods, and releases the XCast instance.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the cast service.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the cast service is enabled.

methods.name: setStandbyBehavior
methods.description: Sets the standby behavior mode.

methods.name: getStandbyBehavior
methods.description: Gets the current standby behavior mode.

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the friendly name for the cast device.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves the current friendly name.

methods.name: getSystemPlugin
methods.description: Initializes the system plugin interface for system info and control.

methods.name: updateSystemFriendlyName
methods.description: Fetches and updates the system's friendly name.

methods.name: onFriendlyNameUpdateHandler
methods.description: Handles updates to the friendly name event.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol version of the cast service.

methods.name: update_friendly_name_timercallback
methods.description: Timer callback to update the friendly name asynchronously.

methods.name: getEntryFromAppLaunchParamList
methods.description: Retrieves application launch parameters from cache.

methods.name: dumpDynamicAppConfigCache
methods.description: Logs current dynamic app configuration cache.

methods.name: deleteFromDynamicAppCache
methods.description: Removes applications from dynamic cache by name.

methods.name: updateDynamicAppCache
methods.description: Updates the dynamic application cache from JSON array.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers applications with the cast service.

methods.name: unregisterApplications
methods.description: Unregisters applications from the cast service.

methods.name: registerApplicationsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to register application info with the cast service.

methods.name: getUrlFromAppLaunchParams
methods.description: Constructs a launch URL based on app name and parameters.

methods.name: event_onApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Triggers application launch with parameters.

methods.name: event_onApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Triggers application launch with URL.

methods.name: event_onApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Triggers application stop event.

methods.name: event_onApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Triggers application hide event.

methods.name: event_onApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Triggers application state request.

methods.name: event_onApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Triggers application resume event.

methods.name: event_onUpdatePowerStateRequest
methods.description: Updates system power state.
